This is an R markdown document for 8105 homework 1.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Probelm 1

Load the penguins dataset
```{r load data}
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
```

The penguins dataset contains some penguin information. Important variables include species, island, bill length (mm), bill depth (mm), flipper length (mm), body mass (g), sex and year. The size of dataset has `r nrow(penguins)` rows and `r ncol(penguins)` columns. 
The mean flipper length is `r mean(penguins$flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE)` mm.

Scatter plot of flipper length vs bill length.
```{r scatterplot}
penguins %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = flipper_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point()
```
Save the plot
```{r save plot}
ggsave("penguin_plot.png")
```
